message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 180, "amount_cents": 13791}, {"order_id": 181, "amount_cents": 17092}, {"order_id": 184, "amount_cents": 3930}]
✔ Verified
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: I need to get each customer's net balance by subtracting the refunds from their orders, then record a payout for each.

The net_balance tool returned an error because the customer ID CUST-180 does not exist. I need to find the correct customer IDs associated with the orders. I will call list_orders to retrieve the order details and get the customer IDs.
I have the list of orders with their customer IDs and amounts. Next, I need to get each customer's net balance (order amounts minus refunds). I will start by calling net_balance for customer 'acme'.
I have the net balance for acme (27136 cents). Next, I need the net balance for birch.
I have the net balance for birch (40931 cents). Next, I need the net balance for cobalt.
I now have all net balances: acme 27136, birch 40931, cobalt 31469. I need to record a payout for each customer.
I have recorded the payout for acme. Next, I need to record the payout for birch.

result.error: bad arguments: World.record_payout() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount_cent'. Did you mean 'amount_cents'?

reply.thought: The previous record_ payout call failed because the argument name was wrong. I need to use "amount_cents" (with an underscore) as the key. I will call record_ payout again for birch with the correct argument name.
I have recorded the payout for birch. Next, I need to record the payout for cobalt.
The tool name was misspelled with an extra space. I need to call record_ payout correctly. I will use the correct tool name "record_payout".
All payouts have been recorded successfully. I need to finish the batch by returning the done report with the payouts map.
